summary: Handles the history of actions related to site profiles, tracking changes, and user actions.
purpose: Maintain a record of changes and actions performed on site profiles for auditing purposes.

fields.name: ID
fields.description: Unique identifier for a site profile history record.

fields.name: ActionDate
fields.description: Date and time when the action took place.

fields.name: ScreenSection
fields.description: Section of the screen where the action was performed.

fields.name: LastName
fields.description: Last name of the user performing the action.

fields.name: FirstName
fields.description: First name of the user performing the action.

fields.name: MiddleName
fields.description: Middle name of the user performing the action.

fields.name: Phone
fields.description: Contact phone number of the user.

fields.name: ByUserID
fields.description: User ID of the person who performed the action.

fields.name: ByOriginalUserID
fields.description: Original user ID when action was performed by a proxy.

fields.name: ByUserSysAdmin
fields.description: Indicator if the action was performed by a system administrator.
